title: GatherV2 and BurnerV2 lack rescueERC20 escape hatch
description: Story-027 added rescueERC20() to BalancerPoolerV2 but GatherV2 and BurnerV2 still lack it. Tokens sent directly to these dispatcher contracts (user error, integration mishap) are permanently stuck with no recovery path. Under normal operation tokens pass through immediately, but direct transfers have no remedy.
impact: Accidentally-transferred tokens are permanently stuck in GatherV2 and BurnerV2.
recommendation: Add rescueERC20(address token, address to, uint256 amount) onlyOwner to the ATokenDispatcherV2 base contract so all dispatchers inherit a uniform recovery path.
